description: Bias analysis of outcome-dependent recording for each speeding type; 'status' says why a row is blank
population: CRSS police-reported crashes 2016-2024 with known maximum severity
method: Matrix-method correction (measurement.corrected_rr) of the crude RR of type vs no speeding for sensitivities and specificity on the measurement-module grid; the bias factor multiplies the model-A adjusted RR
